parole.testo: From Polish blat or Yiddish בלאַט (blat).

parole.significato: Saturday, observed in Judaism as a day of rest, Sabbath.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish szabas from Yiddish שבת (shabes, “Sabbath”), from Hebrew שַׁבָּת (shabát). Doublet of суббо́та (subbóta).

parole.significato: dishonest deal or trade, machinations, shenanigans
parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish szacher-macher or Yiddish שאַכער־מאַכער (shakher-makher), from German Schacher-Macher; compare Romanian șahăr-mahăr.
